title: Caribbean Up-And-Comer of the Month: Malie Donn Upholds Portmore’s Dancehall Legacy With ‘Golden Child’ Debut Album
summary: The Waterford-bred star is Billboard's Caribbean Up-And-Comer of the Month for August.
body: Nearly three years after he burst onto the scene with the easy-riding, Ireland Boss-produced “V6,” ascendant Jamaican dancehall star Malie Donn is finally ready to unleash his debut studio album, The Golden Child . Related Caribbean Up-And-Comer of the Month: Ayetian Is Shaking Up Dancehall by Blending His Haitian & Jamaican Roots Shyne, Patra, Calypso Rose & Alan Cavé Among Special Honorees at 2026 Caribbean Music Awards Caribbean Up-And-Comer of the Month: Lady Lava Chose Her Career Over Being a Housewife — And Inspired Women Across the Diaspora in the Process The 20-track set, which lands on Sept. 4 via VP Records, marks a crowning moment for the artist born Kymalie Hylton. Born and raised in the Waterford neighborhood of Portmore in Jamaica, Malie Donn, 25, is the latest inheritor of a remarkable dancehall lineage. Several genre luminaries came of age in Portmore, including Popcaan, Blak Ryno and Masicka.
